column1: Bonuses with missing/purple video links were edited in, and may be inaccurate! If you have suggestions or wish to help, message 77wi on discord.

This is an edited version of Xtra's Bonus Tiers that was primarily made to include some of the newer and harder bonuses that were exempt from the original spreadsheet. The methodology for tiering the bonuses has largely remained the same, with bonuses only being added after personally having completed them, except for a few bonuses which have been ranked based on accounts of other players.

Above all this, keep in mind that some bonuses may be easier or harder for some, as different surfers have different strengths, preferences, and play style. This also means that the closer ranked two bonuses are to each other, the likelier it is that you might disagree with the ranking.
